scope: Native network; per-junction telemetry is separate from whole-network summaries.
window: Metrics have different windows. Read each definition: measurement reset affects stopped waits/completions/queues, while demand accounting remains cumulative since run start.

unsupported.emissions: Unavailable: no emissions or CO2 model is implemented in the active engine.

metrics.label: Mean stopped vehicle wait
metrics.population: Completed-in-window and currently active admitted vehicles across the network.
metrics.definition: Stopped time accumulated since measurement reset, divided by that completed-plus-active population; speed at most 0.1 m/s. Pending boundary arrivals and pre-reset stopped time are excluded.
metrics.zero: Zero means a nonempty measured population had zero time/speed; an empty population is unavailable.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Mean incoming-lane queue
metrics.population: Incoming lanes of all modeled junctions, including stop-controlled junctions.
metrics.definition: Mean stopped count per incoming lane at each recorded engine tick, averaged over ticks since measurement reset. Vehicles on connectors and outgoing boundary lanes are excluded. Not a signal-cycle average or a total network queue.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Maximum lane queue
metrics.population: Any modeled lane across the network.
metrics.definition: Largest stopped count on any one lane at a recorded tick since measurement reset; speed at most 0.1 m/s. Connector vehicles are excluded. Unlike mean queue, this includes outgoing boundary lanes.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Completed network trips
metrics.population: Trips ending at network boundaries.
metrics.definition: Count of vehicle trips completing since measurement reset. Excludes unfinished trips and local junction passages; a stop-line discharge count is not this measure.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Completed-trip travel time
metrics.population: Trips completing at network boundaries since measurement reset.
metrics.definition: Mean full time from network admission to completion for trips completing in the measurement window. Includes pre-window travel of warmup-born trips; excludes boundary waiting and unfinished trips.
metrics.zero: Zero means a nonempty measured population had zero time/speed; an empty population is unavailable.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Mean pedestrian wait
metrics.population: Completed-in-window and currently active pedestrians across all modeled crossings.
metrics.definition: Accumulated waiting time since measurement reset divided by completed-plus-active pedestrian count. Crossing duration is excluded; active crossers retain their preceding waiting time.
metrics.zero: Zero means a nonempty measured population had zero time/speed; an empty population is unavailable.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Requested vehicles
metrics.population: All vehicle arrivals due by the current simulation time.
metrics.definition: Cumulative count since run start, including warmup, whether admitted, still pending or dropped. Excludes arrivals scheduled in the future.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Admitted vehicles
metrics.population: Vehicles admitted to the network.
metrics.definition: Cumulative admissions since run start, including warmup and vehicles completed before measurement reset. Pending and dropped requests are excluded; this is not the measured average-wait denominator.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Pending boundary arrivals
metrics.population: Due vehicle requests still outside the network.
metrics.definition: Current count waiting for a route or entry space. Includes requests originating in warmup; not included in in-network average stopped wait.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Dropped vehicle requests
metrics.population: Requests refused when the configured pending limit is exceeded.
metrics.definition: Cumulative count since run start, including warmup. Also historically named deferred_demand; these requests are not automatically retried.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Unfinished vehicles
metrics.population: Currently active vehicles plus pending boundary requests.
metrics.definition: Current count at the reported horizon; includes warmup-born requests still unresolved. Dropped requests and completed trips are excluded. Report alongside completed-trip averages.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Pending boundary waiting
metrics.population: Currently pending boundary requests only.
metrics.definition: Sum of current time minus requested arrival time for requests still pending. Includes pre-window waiting of warmup requests; excludes admitted and dropped requests. This is a current pending stock, not all historical boundary delay.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Mean admitted boundary wait
metrics.population: Completed-in-window and currently active admitted vehicles.
metrics.definition: Mean admission time minus requested arrival time for that population. Includes full pre-admission waiting even for warmup-born vehicles; excludes requests still pending and dropped requests.
metrics.zero: Zero means a nonempty measured population had zero time/speed; an empty population is unavailable.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Measurement start / warmup elapsed
metrics.population: Simulation clock from run start.
metrics.definition: Actual simulation time at the latest metric reset. Evaluation uses fixed-time warmup before this reset. Live runs without reset start measuring at zero; use this actual value rather than assuming configured warmup.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Measured duration
metrics.population: Simulation clock since measurement start.
metrics.definition: Elapsed simulation time minus measurement start. Excludes warmup; an interrupted run may measure less than its requested duration.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Scheduled vehicle arrivals
metrics.population: Full exogenous schedule for the configured run horizon.
metrics.definition: Total scheduled arrivals, including warmup and requests not yet due. It is not the number requested so far or the number admitted.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Active admitted vehicles
metrics.population: Vehicles currently inside the network.
metrics.definition: Current count, including connectors and warmup-born vehicles; excludes pending, dropped and completed requests.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Completed trips in window
metrics.population: Vehicle trips completing in the measurement window.
metrics.definition: Same completion count as throughput; resets after warmup. Not lifetime completions.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Completed pedestrian crossings
metrics.population: Pedestrians completing a modeled crossing.
metrics.definition: Count since measurement reset; does not include people still waiting or crossing.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Active pedestrians
metrics.population: People currently waiting or crossing.
metrics.definition: Current count across all modeled crossings, including warmup-born pedestrians; excludes completed and dropped pedestrians.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Dropped pedestrian requests
metrics.population: Pedestrian arrivals refused by the configured active limit.
metrics.definition: Cumulative count since run start, including warmup. Refused requests are not automatically retried.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Current mean vehicle speed
metrics.population: Currently active admitted vehicles.
metrics.definition: Snapshot mean speed across active vehicles, including connectors. Not a journey average, and pending arrivals are excluded.
metrics.zero: Zero means a nonempty measured population had zero time/speed; an empty population is unavailable.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Completed-trip rate
metrics.population: Trips completing in the measurement window.
metrics.definition: Completed network trips multiplied by 3600 and divided by measured seconds. A scaled rate, not an observed one-hour count.
metrics.zero: Zero means no completions over a positive measured duration; no elapsed measurement is unavailable.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Local observation / custom measure
metrics.population: Researcher-defined location, population and window.
metrics.definition: Enter a simulated measurement extracted at the same location, times and definition as the field reference. Cite the extraction method; no automatic local metric is inferred.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded zero count or duration, not evidence of missing coverage.
metrics.unavailable: Missing/non-finite values are unavailable. Averages also require recorded nonempty population counts; sampled queues require at least one recorded metric tick.

metrics.label: Current network vehicle density
metrics.population: Currently active admitted vehicles, including connectors.
metrics.definition: Active admitted count divided by total modeled lane length in kilometres; pending requests are excluded. This is not density per city road-kilometre.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Measured stopped vehicle time
metrics.population: Completed-in-window plus currently active admitted vehicles.
metrics.definition: Sum of accumulated stopped time since measurement reset; pending boundary waiting is excluded. This is the numerator of mean stopped vehicle wait.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Measured pedestrian waiting time
metrics.population: Completed-in-window plus currently active pedestrians.
metrics.definition: Sum of accumulated pedestrian waiting time since measurement reset; crossing duration is excluded. This is the numerator of mean pedestrian wait.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Completed trips since run start
metrics.population: Network-boundary trip completions.
metrics.definition: Cumulative count since run start, including warmup. Unlike throughput, this counter is not reset after warmup.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Route changes since run start
metrics.population: Admitted vehicles whose remaining route changes.
metrics.definition: Cumulative reroute count since run start, including warmup. A route change does not prove a faster trip; signal learning does not choose routes.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Policy decisions in window
metrics.population: Inference decisions at the selected RL junction.
metrics.definition: Count since measurement reset. Requested service is subject to clearance and shared safety rules; this is not a count of successfully changed phases.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Safety service requests in window
metrics.population: Safety override requests recorded by the engine.
metrics.definition: Count since measurement reset, separate from learned decisions. A request count is not a pedestrian outcome.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Recorded metric ticks
metrics.population: Recorded engine metric samples.
metrics.definition: Number of metric samples since measurement reset. Queue means and maxima require at least one recorded tick.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Vehicles stuck inside a junction
metrics.population: Active vehicles holding a junction reservation.
metrics.definition: Vehicles that hold a junction reservation and have been stopped for more than 30 s. The entry rule guarantees room to clear the junction, so any non-zero value indicates an engine fault, not traffic.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Gridlock duration
metrics.population: All active vehicles.
metrics.definition: Seconds without any vehicle movement once that exceeds 60 s while at least one vehicle waits at its stop line on green (or at an all-way stop) for downstream space. Waiting at a red signal does not count. Zero means no gridlock is in progress.
metrics.zero: Zero means no gridlock is in progress; it is not proof of realistic traffic.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Vehicle demand accounting error
metrics.population: All due vehicle requests since run start.
metrics.definition: Requested minus lifetime completed minus active minus pending minus dropped vehicles. Zero indicates balanced accounting, not field realism.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.

metrics.label: Pedestrian accounting error
metrics.population: All generated pedestrian requests since run start.
metrics.definition: Generated minus lifetime completed minus active minus dropped pedestrians. Zero indicates balanced accounting, not verified observation coverage.
metrics.zero: Zero is a recorded count or balanced accounting; it is not proof of missing coverage or field validity.
metrics.unavailable: Missing or non-finite values are unavailable.
